notes.title: It's time for the interview 🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45581960/0e5541e865e099d2d2d37e81666e8f88cf218a75.png[/img]

📅 Today’s the [b]BIG [/b]day. After months of brainstorming, "disruptive synergies," and strategic naps, [i]Very Unserious Game[/i] is finally AVAILABLE for free on Steam! 🚀

On the menu:
[list]
[*] Graphics that definitely exist ✅
[*] Characters that are more or less endearing ✅
[*] A disruptive plot that seriously disrupts ✅
[*] Achievements carefully designed to maximize emotional retention and turn every micro-interaction into a scalable lever for playful loyalty ✅
[*] Bugs? Nah, we call those dynamic surprise features ✅
[/list]

So what are you waiting for? Download Very Unserious Game and awaken the inner CEO within you 🦁

---

To speak a bit more [i]seriously[/i], we want to thank everyone who supported us throughout the development of this project, and everyone who will play Very Unserious Game.

Feel free to follow our Steam creator pages so you don't miss our future announcements!
